plan.title: Capstone: Solo Lifecycle Walkthrough, Rubric, and Solution

narratives.Description: Author the two-hour self-directed capstone that teaches a learner to supervise the guarded fixture from orientation through evidence-based closeout. The curriculum, practical lab, assessment rubric, progressive hints, recovery guidance, and explained solution must be complete without undocumented instructor help or a live review service.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Write the capstone overview, stepwise lab, evidence rubric, and explained solution around the fixture's exact stage contract, including starting-state checks, checkpoints, literal commands, expected failures, bounded reset and cleanup, and completion-state distinctions.
2. Add a focused content verifier and negative tests, wire exact npm commands and every learner/maintainer index, record immutable source and platform evidence, and update glossary, quick reference, maintenance guidance, and changelog without overstating unexecuted platforms or changing the learner release pin.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer, I want a complete written solo Directive capstone with objective evidence and recovery, so that I can prove I can manage one safe change without live instructor assistance.
narratives.Traces: training.capstone.walkthrough; parent Description, Acceptance, QualityGate, and Traces; PROJECT-DEFINITION CourseShape, LearningGoals, SupportedEnvironments, ReviewModel, and ProjectRules

narrative.Acceptance: Given a learner submission, the assessment maps every capstone outcome to named artifacts and observable evidence, distinguishes implemented, PR-open, merge-ready, delivered, deployed, and UAT-verified states, supplies a self-evaluation rubric and completion statement, and does not award completion for reading the solution or presenting stale or unsupported evidence.
narrative.Traces: parent Acceptance; PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals and ReviewModel

items.title: Enforce the full capstone content contract

narrative.Acceptance: When the focused verifier and negative tests run, they reject missing artifacts or outcome mappings, broken links, unfinished markers, unsafe executable commands, reordered lifecycle stages, omitted checkpoints or evidence, weakened gates, live-service dependencies, unsupported platform claims, stale planned-status text, altered pins, and incomplete reset, archive, cleanup, rubric, or solution sections; the parent literal conformance command and separate aggregate merge gate pass afterward.

items.title: Provide progressive help and an explained solution

narrative.Acceptance: Given a failed starting check or stage gate, the capstone shows progressive hints one at a time, provides failure-specific recovery without weakening tests or gates, creates a fresh attempt on reset, and lets the learner compare a genuine first attempt against a complete explained solution that includes reasoning, exact expected evidence, valid alternatives, misconceptions, retry, archive, and cleanup.
